application databases used by the Agency to collect information on eligible recipients must record disbursements;
such tracking is designed to highlight and identify ineligible applications; and
the databases used to collect information from applications for such assistance must be integrated with disbursements and payment records.

tree.heading: Audits and reviews required
tree.text: The Administrator shall ensure that any database or similar application processing system for Federal disaster relief assistance programs administered by the Agency undergoes a review by the Inspector General of the Agency to determine the existence and implementation of such internal controls required under this section and the amendments made by this section.

notes.heading: References in Text
notes.text: For the amendments made by this section, referred to in subsec. (b), see Codification note below.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section is comprised of section 696 of Pub. L. 109–295. Subsec. (c) of section 696 of Pub. L. 109–295 amended section 5174 of Title 42, The Public Health and Welfare.
